title: Devoted Hearts of Master and Servant

text_block_list.text:
A rest day during summer training camp.
I returned to my room to tend to the rose
cutting
that had gradually taken root and grown.
There was much to watch out for,
from drying out to root rot.
choice_data_list: Still, it really is hot today...

text_block_list.text:
The perils of blazing sun and searing heat
fall upon all equally.
Upon humans, upon Umamusume,
and upon roses alike.
choice_data_list: I hope we can get through the summ...
I hope we can make it through the ...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Trainer.
How did the roses look?
choice_data_list: It's doing fine somehow; it shot u...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see... Hm?
Is that book a rose gardening guide?
choice_data_list: Yes, the horticulturist we spoke o...

text_block_list.text:
My correspondence with the one who showed
me the profound depth of rose breeding
continued,
sharing regular updates on their growth and
receiving guidance in return.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Your enthusiasm is most commendable.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
By the way,
I was just invited for a stroll.
I shall be spending the evening with Pisa
and the others.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to spend your time however you
please as well.
choice_data_list: Understood. I shall spend the time...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Heh... I thought as much.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I pray that it weathers the summer,
endures the winter,
and brings forth its roses safely into
bloom.

The summer training camp,
and everything else.
All proceeded smoothly,
and the days flew by in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp will soon come to
an end. As far as results go,
it hasn't been bad.
choice_data_list: I believe you have trained more th...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
However,
the others are gaining strength as well.
Complacency is strictly forbidden.

text_block_list.name: Excited Student A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey.
Wanna check out the festival tonight?
A little treat to reward ourselves for
busting our tails at training camp♪

text_block_list.name: Excited Student B
text_block_list.text:
No way, I'm so there!
We can totally watch the fireworks too,
right?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Festival stalls, fireworks.
choice_data_list: Shall we go? As a reward for you a...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If anyone is due a reward, it is you as well,
Trainer.
You have served me most faithfully.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To spend your spare hours refining my training
menu...
You could have devoted that time to the
roses instead.
choice_data_list: No, both are vital duties.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...A mission?
choice_data_list: Supporting you, Lady Rose, and—

text_block_list.text:
Cultivating a rose worthy of the kingdom.
When I conveyed my resolve to see it through
no matter what,
her expression inexplicably shifted.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Wait.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Most likely.
There appears to be...
a major misunderstanding between us.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...How dreadful.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
An order to cultivate roses, you say...
Is that truly how you interpreted it?
choice_data_list: Yes... To think it was all out of ...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—On that day,
the gaze you fixed upon the rose was so
utterly earnest.
I knew right then: "This is the one."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I thought nurturing a single blossom might
bring some richness to your daily life.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
However...
To think I've ended up burdening you with
even more work instead.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
You no longer need to tend to the roses.
I shall see to their care from now on.
...I am sorry.

Afterward,
unable to do anything but watch her walk
away,
I stood rooted to the spot for a long
while.

—Things cannot go on like this.
It was quite some time later that I returned
to the training camp lodge with that
realization.
choice_data_list: (I'll apologize. And then invite h...

text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Training Camp Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Rose Kingdom-san?
I heard she was heading out until tomorrow's
rest day, though.
choice_data_list: How could this be...!

text_block_list.text:
Knowing my gentle liege,
they may have felt too ashamed to face me.
Still, where could they have gone?

For someone so sheltered from the ways of
the world,
the places she could wander are few.
Out of those,
the most likely destination is—
choice_data_list: (That's it! Her clan should have a...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(I was well aware of his devotion.
Why could I not foresee the possibility of
a misunderstanding?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(I was well aware of her devotion.
Why could I not foresee the possibility of
a misunderstanding?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...If I cannot even fathom the heart of the
one closest to me,
how could I ever hope to become a worthy
king?
choice_data_list: That... feels a little too close t...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What...!?
How did you know about this place—
choice_data_list: What a relief, I didn't misread th...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I am sorry. Once again,
I have caused you trouble.

"I don't consider it the slightest trouble
at all."
Saying so,
I brewed tea for the dejected girl.
choice_data_list: Let's talk, so there are no misund...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Delicious.
Your tea is always wonderful.
choice_data_list: I am honored.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
You are always like this. For my sake,
for the clan's sake.
...Even these roses, this time.
choice_data_list: Yes, but... that is not all.

text_block_list.text:
It is true that I strove to fulfill the
imperial decree. Yet on that day,
when I beheld the roses resembling my noble
master and her clan,
my thought that they were beautiful was just
as true.
choice_data_list: Both are the honest truth of who I am.

text_block_list.text:
And—at the botanical garden I visited once
more,
I learned the profundity and harshness of
cultivating roses,
yet also the nobility of those who pursue
their ideals nonetheless.
choice_data_list: Do you remember what we talked abo...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
'I found myself wanting to bring an ideal
rose to bloom,' he said.
choice_data_list: That was simply my own desire.

text_block_list.text:
When Rose Kingdom establishes her domain,
she shall have roses worthy of the garden
greeting a monarch's triumphant return.

For a benevolent, diligent monarch,
and the subjects who believed in her...
She wished to craft a national flower that
would grant peace to their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Desire...? You claim that is your desire?
choice_data_list: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Heh, haha...!
...Ah, what a turn of events.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: My Trainer truly remains unshakeable.
choice_data_list: Um, Lady Rose……?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
What you called desire...
is it not, in the end,
for myself and our clan?
choice_data_list: Huh? No, that's... well, um,

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Very well, you are pardoned.
That nature of yours will not change so easily,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: In exchange, permit me to make a vow.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I shall become a splendid sovereign.
A ruler worthy of you,
and of the roses cultivated with your
steadfast devotion.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
That is why—someday.
When that long-cherished wish is finally
fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Please brew tea for me again in your rose
garden.
